remarks:
Welcome to 125 Edward St. in Allentown.  This historic building has been tastefully converted to condo living.  St. Mary's Square is a great place to live downtown and close to all the great things our city has to offer.  

Enter the front door into the mail room where a key access entry door takes you into the foyer where a key access elevator takes you to the 4th floor.  

A few steps from the elevator is Unit 4D featuring  lots of natural light with views of downtown Buffalo.  An open concept makes for gracious living.  The entry area has a double closet and plenty of space. The fully applianced galley kitchen features plentiful cupboards. 

A Living Room/Dining area features hardwood floors and an artificial fireplace that can be included in the sale.  French doors open to the bedroom (currently used as an office and TV room).  The cathedral ceilings in this unit gives a great feeling of space.   Adjacent  to the bedroom is a double wide closet and full bath.  The full bath has a large step in shower and neutral finishes.

A locked storage unit is in the basement along with locked storage for bicycles.  Pay as you go Laundry is in the bright and clean basement.  Locked parking area with one assigned space (#22).  

Showings through showing time - but MUST be confirmed with the listing agents as there are certain time
restrictions.  Showings begin on 5/12/2026 at 9:00 AM. Seller reserves the right to set an offer deadline.

Owner may rent unit with board approval and 1 year lease. Dogs up to 25lbs allowed.
